resources.string: Scan documents without giving them away.
RME PDF Scanner is designed to process documents on your device, without accounts, ads, or tracking.
Bring existing JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF scans into the same on-device workflow.

No account · No ads · Local document handling
Documents are intended to be processed locally.
Documents are stored only when you choose Save to RME. Saved pages and recognized text remain in app-private storage until you delete them or remove the app data.
RME PDF Scanner does not operate cloud storage.
Users will choose where exported files are saved or shared.
RME PDF Scanner does not operate advertising, tracking, or analytics.
Google ML Kit may send encrypted technical diagnostics. It does not send your document images or recognized text.
